import json

courses = [
    {'name': 'Python Fundamentals', 'credits': 3},
    {'name': 'Web Development', 'credits': 4},
    {'name': 'Data Science', 'credits': 3},
]

# Same payload that JsonResponse({'courses': courses}) renders for GET /courses/
body = json.dumps({'courses': courses})

# The expected output shows only the first course followed by an ellipsis
first = json.dumps(courses[0])
print('GET /courses/ → {"courses": [' + first + ', ...]}')
